block.shulespotions.potion_cauldron.comm: My old and reliable cauldron... It brings back memories of my first brew.
block.shulespotions.potion_cauldron.desc:
To use the potion cauldron, you must first fill it with a water bucket.
Then, by adding ingredients, your mixture will gain a chance to get a specific effect.
You will know if you got it or not after mixing the liquid with a spoon.
block.shulespotions.copper_cauldron.comm: Copper is not only beautiful, it has conductive properties... Or so the old alchemists used to say.
block.shulespotions.copper_cauldron.desc: An upgraded version of the traditional cauldron. Thanks to the thermal properties of copper, this cauldron allows mixing more ingredients than normal.
block.shulespotions.spoon_rack.commentar: A respectable place where my tools can rest.
block.shulespotions.spoon_rack.descripti: The spoon rack allows you to store and display up to 3 different spoons at the same time. By interacting with it, you can comfortably hang them so they are always at hand during preparation.
item.shulespotions.wooden_spoon.commenta: A simple stick, turned into a magnificent tool...
item.shulespotions.wooden_spoon.descript: Spoons are used to consolidate a mixture. When you consider that your liquid is ready (or when your cauldron is already full), use the spoon to finish the process. If everything goes well, you can now bottle your potion. If not... well... let's hope it's not too bad.
item.shulespotions.sponge_spoon.commenta: It seems to absorb the liquid with each mix...
item.shulespotions.sponge_spoon.descript: The sponge spoon absorbs a random effect from your potion. This completely removes the effect, but increases the purity of the mixture by 2 points.
item.shulespotions.golden_spoon.commenta: So shiny... it's a masterpiece... a relic!
item.shulespotions.golden_spoon.descript: The golden spoon, with its majestic properties, doubles the duration and purity of your potion!
item.shulespotions.stone_spoon.descripti: The stone spoon increases the duration of your potion by 20 seconds.
item.shulespotions.iron_spoon.commentary: A sturdy spoon, not much else to say.
item.shulespotions.iron_spoon.descriptio: The iron spoon increases the duration of your potion by 40 seconds.
item.shulespotions.diamond_spoon.comment: An unnecessary luxury, but very effective.
item.shulespotions.diamond_spoon.descrip: The diamond spoon increases the duration of your potion by 1 minute.
item.shulespotions.bastion_spoon.comment: I can still hear the drums of war!
item.shulespotions.bastion_spoon.descrip: The bastion spoon follows the rule of the strongest! It consumes the weakest effect, removing it from your brew, to ensure that the strongest effect remains in your potion.
item.shulespotions.ender_spoon.commentar: This spoon has a glow that defies logic itself...
item.shulespotions.ender_spoon.descripti: The Ender spoon prevents your brew from failing... At the cost of sacrificing your strongest effect.
item.shulespotions.pestle.commentary: A tool meticulously carved for extreme pressure and friction tasks... Or well... A hard rock for the ignorant.
item.shulespotions.pestle.description: The pestle is essential for crafting powders. Use it on a filled mortar to start grinding its ingredients.
block.shulespotions.mortar.commentary: Ideal for refining alchemical elements... Or to make a good sauce.
block.shulespotions.mortar.description: To refine elements using the mortar, you must first fill it with the material you want. Then, you must crush its contents using the pestle. When the inside is a uniform mass, you can remove the contents using a bowl.
item.shulespotions.small_potion_bottle.d: The Small Bottle is ideal for a quick drink, capable of storing up to 1 potion charge.
item.shulespotions.large_potion_bottle.d: The most basic bottle possible. It stores the mighty amount of 2 potion charges.
item.shulespotions.big_potion_bottle.des: This bottle is the older sister. It can store the humble amount of 3 potion charges.
item.shulespotions.throwable_potion_bott: Why drink something if you can throw it in your enemies' faces?
The throwable bottle allows you to use potions as projectiles. Upon impact, the glass breaks and creates a puddle of liquid that affects any entity that steps on it, ideal for ranged combat!
item.shulespotions.recipe_scroll.comment: A good alchemist must document everything, EVERYTHING!...
item.shulespotions.recipe_scroll.descrip: Scrolls are a great way to save recipes of your interest. In it, besides being able to see the ingredients of a brew, you can also see its effects and stats.
item.shulespotions.ghast_heart.descripti: The heart of an ethereal creature, extracted straight from its dead body...
item.shulespotions.bat_ear.description: I didn't mean to do that, little one...
item.shulespotions.allay_essence.descrip: This one was hard to catch...
item.shulespotions.copper_dust.descripti: Three copper ingots ground in a mortar. Pretty simple, right?
item.shulespotions.diamond_dust.descript: Grind three diamonds in a mortar? Sounds physically impossible, but... who cares?
item.shulespotions.amethyst_dust.descrip: Three ground amethysts. I must admit the dust looks very pretty... It even looks tasty... should I...?
item.shulespotions.netherite_dust.descri: After what it cost me to get three netherite ingots, was it a bad idea to grind them?... Probably.
item.shulespotions.gold_dust.description: Three ground gold ingots... my predecessors would lose their minds, ha!
item.shulespotions.emerald_dust.descript: I saw two villagers selling this in secret... I don't know what they'll use it for, I just know I managed to replicate it by grinding three emeralds.
item.shulespotions.crushed_eye.descripti: Crushed spider eyes... I've seen worse, but I'm still not used to the smell.
item.shulespotions.iron_dust.description: Ground iron, I guess... I'll be able to use it for something... maybe at some point.
item.shulespotions.rotten_melon_slice.de: I guess it was a bad idea to store food next to rotten flesh... Now, what am I going to eat? :(
item.shulespotions.rotten_carrot.descrip: I guess it was a bad idea to store food next to rotten flesh... Now, what am I going to eat? :(
item.shulespotions.rotten_fish.descripti: I guess it was a bad idea to store food next to rotten flesh... Now, what am I going to eat? :(
item.shulespotions.rotten_apple.descript: I guess it was a bad idea to store food next to rotten flesh... Now, what am I going to eat? :(
item.shulespotions.bastion_fragment.desc: A pretty stone obtained probably from the most dangerous place in hell. Sure! Why not?
item.shulespotions.fragmented_ender_pear: Despite being broken, it still seems to retain its properties.
item.shulespotions.nitro_spores.descript: I finally discovered how creepers reproduce, it's surprising, disgusting and gives me a bit of an allergy...
item.shulespotions.mandrake_seed.descrip: This thing simply came out of the grass and started screaming... I can still hear its screams...
effect.minecraft.absorption.description: Grants the user additional health that absorbs damage before their normal health is affected.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.description: Marks the target with an ominous aura that triggers a raid when entering a village.
effect.minecraft.blindness.description: Reduces the target's vision range and prevents sprinting.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.descripti: Grants the user the ability to breathe underwater, see clearly underwater, and mine faster while submerged.
effect.minecraft.darkness.description: Reduces the target's vision, making the surroundings appear dark.
effect.minecraft.dolphins_grace.descript: Increases the user's swimming speed while moving through water.
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.descrip: Grants the user immunity to fire and lava damage.
effect.minecraft.glowing.description: Causes the target to glow, making them visible through blocks.
effect.minecraft.haste.description: Increases the user's mining and attack speed.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Grants the user discounts and gifts when trading with villagers.
effect.minecraft.hunger.description: Causes the target to lose hunger faster over time.
effect.minecraft.instant_damage.descript: Instantly deals damage to the target.
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.description: Increases the user's jump height and reduces fall damage.
effect.minecraft.levitation.description: Causes the target to float upward.
effect.minecraft.luck.description: Improves the user's chances of obtaining better loot from certain sources.
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.descript: Reduces the target's mining and attack speed.
effect.minecraft.nausea.description: Distorts the target's vision, causing the world to appear distorted.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.descriptio: Allows the user to see clearly in darkness and underwater.
effect.minecraft.poison.description: Deals damage to the target over time but cannot kill them.
effect.minecraft.regeneration.descriptio: Restores the user's health over time.
effect.minecraft.resistance.description: Reduces damage taken by the user from most sources.
effect.minecraft.saturation.description: Restores the user's hunger and saturation instantly.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.descriptio: Allows the user to fall slowly and prevents fall damage.
effect.minecraft.strength.description: Increases the user's melee attack damage.
effect.minecraft.unluck.description: Reduces the target's chances of obtaining better loot from certain sources.
effect.minecraft.water_breathing.descrip: Allows the user to breathe underwater.
effect.minecraft.weakness.description: Reduces the target's melee attack damage.
effect.minecraft.wither.description: Deals damage to the target over time and can kill them.
effect.shulespotions.comeback.descriptio: Returns the user to their spawn point.
effect.shulespotions.ender_disruption.de: Grants the user the ability to avoid incoming projectiles.
effect.shulespotions.fly.description: Grants the user the ability to fly.
effect.shulespotions.infested.descriptio: Infects the target, causing it to spawn silverfish when hit.
effect.shulespotions.instability.descrip: Causes the target to move frenetically and involuntarily.
effect.shulespotions.nether_corruption.d: Causes the target to corrupt the world behind it, transforming it into the Nether.
effect.shulespotions.leech.description: Allows the user to steal health from targets when attacking them.
effect.shulespotions.oozing.description: Causes the target to spawn slimes upon death.
effect.shulespotions.potion_splashed.des: Obscures the target's vision with potion liquid.
effect.shulespotions.shadow_manipulation: Grants the user the ability to summon shadow clones on hit. The clones chase the user's target and strike once before disappearing.
effect.shulespotions.stone_crusher.descr: Grants the user the ability to break multiple blocks at the same time.
effect.shulespotions.cloning.description: Through biological processes that I do not yet understand, it creates an exact copy of the target.
effect.shulespotions.high_gravity.descri: Manipulates the target's gravitational field, increasing it and making them heavier.
effect.shulespotions.low_gravity.descrip: Manipulates the target's gravitational field, reducing it and making them lighter.
effect.shulespotions.craft_master.descri: Improves the user's manual skills, allowing them to save materials when crafting.
effect.shulespotions.butter_fingers.desc: Causes the items the target is holding to slip from their hands.
effect.shulespotions.fertilizer.descript: Generates accelerated growth in plants around the user.
effect.shulespotions.potion_migraine.des: Causes the target's head to fill with potion liquid. When the effect ends, their head will explode.
effect.shulespotions.orbital_gravity.des: Manipulates the gravitational field of entities near the target, causing them to orbit around it.
effect.shulespotions.swap.description: Swaps the target's position with the user's.
effect.shulespotions.explosive_sneeze.de: Causes the user's sneezes to release nitroglycerin. In simple words, a big BOOM!
effect.shulespotions.frost_walk.descript: Temporarily freezes the water at the user's feet.
effect.alexsmobs.bug_pheromones.descript: Prevents arthropods from being hostile to the user.
effect.alexsmobs.clinging.description: Allows the user to stick to surfaces and walk on ceilings.
effect.alexsmobs.fleet_footed.descriptio: Increases the user's speed while jumping.
effect.alexsmobs.knockback_resistance.de: Reduces or eliminates knockback received by the user.
effect.alexsmobs.lava_vision.description: Allows the user to see clearly through lava.
effect.alexsmobs.mosquito_repellent.desc: Prevents Crimson Mosquitoes from attacking the user.
effect.alexsmobs.oiled.description: Causes the user to float in water.
effect.alexsmobs.orcas_might.description: Reduces the recovery time for melee attacks.
effect.alexsmobs.poison_resistance.descr: Prevents the user from receiving the poison effect.
effect.alexsmobs.soulsteal.description: Allows the user to recover health equal to the damage dealt.
effect.alexsmobs.sunbird_blessing.descri: Grants the user slow falling, increased jump height, and improved aerial mobility.
effect.alexsmobs.tigers_blessing.descrip: Allows the user to interact with tigers and receive their help.
effect.alexsmobs.earthquake.description: Causes the user's screen to shake violently.
effect.alexsmobs.debilitating_sting.desc: Weakens the target, dealing progressive damage or immobilizing arthropods.
effect.alexsmobs.ender_flu.description: Infects the target and spawns an Enderiophage when the effect ends.
effect.alexsmobs.exsanguination.descript: Causes the target to continuously lose health from bleeding.
effect.alexsmobs.fear.description: Paralyzes the target due to fear, limiting their movement.
effect.alexsmobs.power_down.description: Causes a blackout, drastically reducing the target's mobility and vision.
effect.froglins.infection.description: Profanes the target's body, turning them into a disgusting zombie froglin upon death.

tooltip.shulespotions.spoon.wooden: Use it on a cauldron to finish your potion!
tooltip.shulespotions.spoon.bastion: Consumes the weakest effect to ensure the strongest effect.
tooltip.shulespotions.spoon.sponge: Removes a random effect to increase purity
tooltip.shulespotions.spoon.ender: Prevents the potion from failing, in exchange for the strongest effect

shulespotions.screen.effect_codex.purity: The Purity of a potion makes it stronger. Each point of Purity equals one potion effect level.
shulespotions.screen.effect_codex.durati: The Duration of a potion determines how long it lasts.
shulespotions.screen.effect_codex.stabil: The Stability of a potion prevents the alchemist from suffering a chaotic event. Always keep it at high values!
shulespotions.screen.effect_codex.flavor: The Flavor of a potion determines the amount of hunger it restores (or depletes) when drunk.
shulespotions.screen.effect_codex.vitali: The Vitality of a potion determines the amount of health it restores (or depletes) when drunk.
shulespotions.codex.item.commentary: The Alchemist has left no notes on this...
shulespotions.codex.epilogue.title: Epilogue
shulespotions.codex.epilogue.text1:
In the following manuscript, I will proceed to instruct you, reader, about the beautiful art of Alchemy.
My name? You don't need to know it...
When knowledge is the indisputable goal of a writer, there are no nominations or awards to give.
For this very reason, I hope my knowledge embodied in these pages will be of help to you someday...
shulespotions.codex.epilogue.text2:
Over the years I have perfected the art of alchemy, discovering unique brews, ingredients with unmatched properties, and ancient dangers along my path...
So in this way, my dear reader, I welcome you to this hidden world. You may now advance to Chapter I.
shulespotions.codex.chapter1.title: I. The Basic Mix
shulespotions.codex.chapter1.text1: Your journey begins with a %s. Fill it with a water bucket and throw ingredients into it. Each ingredient alters the mixture and gives a chance to get different effects.
shulespotions.codex.chapter1.text2: Be careful: the mixture has its limits. Throwing things randomly without thinking will only cause your brew to ruin, explode, or even worse...
shulespotions.codex.chapter2.title: II. Consolidation
shulespotions.codex.chapter2.text1: Every potion has Stats. To finish your recipe you must use a %s to mix it. Different tools alter the stats in their own way.
shulespotions.codex.chapter2.text2: Keep an eye on Stability! If you mix the potion when its stability is very low, an alchemical disaster will occur instead of a potion.
shulespotions.codex.chapter3.title: III. Bottling
shulespotions.codex.chapter3.text1: If the mixture is successful and the bubbles disappear, congratulations! You have managed to form your first brew. Now use one of the different bottles on the cauldron to bottle your creation.
shulespotions.codex.chapter3.text2: Even so, a true alchemist does not rely on luck. Use an %s to inspect the stats of the ingredients and your mixture before ruining everything.
